CHỦ ĐỀ #1 / 150 · 1. HOUSE & HOME LIVING · NHÀ CỬA & ĐỜI SỐNG

#1. In the House: Living Room (客厅) · 21 từ vựng

↺ Chủ đề 150Chủ đề 2 →

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #1: 客厅)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “客厅” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “kètīng” hé “shāfā” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「客厅」吧！你知道“客厅”和“沙发”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "In the House: Living Room"! Do you know how to use "living room" (客厅) and "sofa / couch" (沙发)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào kètīng, shāfā háiyǒu chájī.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到客厅、沙发还有茶几。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use living room (客厅), sofa / couch (沙发), and coffee table (茶几).
ANà “diànshì” hé “yáokòngqì” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“电视”和“遥控器”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "television" (电视) and "remote control" (遥控器)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì diànshì, yáokòngqì hé dìtǎn, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是电视、遥控器和地毯，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially television (电视), remote control (遥控器), and carpet / rug (地毯)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

CHỦ ĐỀ #2 / 150 · 1. HOUSE & HOME LIVING · NHÀ CỬA & ĐỜI SỐNG

#2. In the House: Bedroom (卧室) · 21 từ vựng

← Chủ đề 1Chủ đề 3 →

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #2: 卧室)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “卧室” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “wòshì” hé “chuáng” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「卧室」吧！你知道“卧室”和“床”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "In the House: Bedroom"! Do you know how to use "bedroom" (卧室) and "bed" (床)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào wòshì, chuáng háiyǒu chuángdiàn.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到卧室、床还有床垫。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use bedroom (卧室), bed (床), and mattress (床垫).
ANà “bèizi” hé “chuángdān” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“被子”和“床单”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "quilt / duvet" (被子) and "bed sheet" (床单)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì bèizi, chuángdān hé zhěntou, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是被子、床单和枕头，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially quilt / duvet (被子), bed sheet (床单), and pillow (枕头)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

#3. In the House: Kitchen (厨房) · 21 từ vựng

← Chủ đề 2Chủ đề 4 →

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #3: 厨房)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “厨房” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “chúfáng” hé “bīngxiāng” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「厨房」吧！你知道“厨房”和“冰箱”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "In the House: Kitchen"! Do you know how to use "kitchen" (厨房) and "refrigerator" (冰箱)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào chúfáng, bīngxiāng háiyǒu ránqìzào.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到厨房、冰箱还有燃气灶。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use kitchen (厨房), refrigerator (冰箱), and gas stove (燃气灶).
ANà “chōuyóuyānjī” hé “wēibōlú” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“抽油烟机”和“微波炉”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "range hood" (抽油烟机) and "microwave oven" (微波炉)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì chōuyóuyānjī, wēibōlú hé kǎoxiāng, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是抽油烟机、微波炉和烤箱，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！

#18. Flavors, Tastes & Seasonings (调味品与口味) · 21 từ vựng

← Chủ đề 17Chủ đề 19 →

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #18: 调味品与口味)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “调味品与口味” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “suān” hé “tián” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「调味品与口味」吧！你知道“酸”和“甜”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Flavors, Tastes & Seasonings"! Do you know how to use "sour" (酸) and "sweet" (甜)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào suān, tián háiyǒu kǔ.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到酸、甜还有苦。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use sour (酸), sweet (甜), and bitter (苦).
ANà “là” hé “xián” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“辣”和“咸”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "spicy / hot" (辣) and "salty" (咸)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì là, xián hé má, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是辣、咸和麻，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially spicy / hot (辣), salty (咸), and numbing (Sichuan pepper flavor) (麻)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

← Chủ đề 18Chủ đề 20 →

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #19: 餐馆与外出就餐)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “餐馆与外出就餐” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “cānguǎn” hé “fúwùyuán” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「餐馆与外出就餐」吧！你知道“餐馆”和“服务员”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Restaurant & Dining Out"! Do you know how to use "restaurant" (餐馆) and "waiter / waitress" (服务员)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào cānguǎn, fúwùyuán háiyǒu càidān.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到餐馆、服务员还有菜单。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use restaurant (餐馆), waiter / waitress (服务员), and menu (菜单).
ANà “diǎncài” hé “yùdìng” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“点菜”和“预订”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "to order food" (点菜) and "to book / to reserve a table" (预订)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì diǎncài, yùdìng hé mǎidān, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是点菜、预订和买单，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially to order food (点菜), to book / to reserve a table (预订), and to pay the bill (买单)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

→ Yes, especially Shandong cuisine (鲁菜), Jiangsu cuisine (苏菜), and Peking roast duck (北京烤鸭)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

#22. Snacks & Street Food (零食与街头小吃) · 21 từ vựng

← Chủ đề 21Chủ đề 23 →

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #22: 零食与街头小吃)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “零食与街头小吃” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “língshí” hé “xiǎochī” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「零食与街头小吃」吧！你知道“零食”和“小吃”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Snacks & Street Food"! Do you know how to use "snacks" (零食) and "street food / light snack" (小吃)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào língshí, xiǎochī háiyǒu shǔpiàn.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到零食、小吃还有薯片。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use snacks (零食), street food / light snack (小吃), and potato chips (薯片).
ANà “bàomǐhuā” hé “jiānguǒ” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“爆米花”和“坚果”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "popcorn" (爆米花) and "nuts" (坚果)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì bàomǐhuā, jiānguǒ hé guāzǐ, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是爆米花、坚果和瓜子，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially popcorn (爆米花), nuts (坚果), and sunflower / melon seeds (瓜子)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

#23. Tea & Chinese Tea Culture (茶与茶文化) · 21 từ vựng

← Chủ đề 22Chủ đề 24 →

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #23: 茶与茶文化)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “茶与茶文化” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “cháyè” hé “lǜchá” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「茶与茶文化」吧！你知道“茶叶”和“绿茶”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Tea & Chinese Tea Culture"! Do you know how to use "tea leaves" (茶叶) and "green tea" (绿茶)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào cháyè, lǜchá háiyǒu hóngchá.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到茶叶、绿茶还有红茶。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use tea leaves (茶叶), green tea (绿茶), and black tea (红茶).
ANà “wūlóngchá” hé “báichá” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“乌龙茶”和“白茶”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "oolong tea" (乌龙茶) and "white tea" (白茶)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì wūlóngchá, báichá hé pǔ'ěrchá, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是乌龙茶、白茶和普洱茶，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially oolong tea (乌龙茶), white tea (白茶), and Pu-erh fermented tea (普洱茶)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “咖啡与咖啡馆” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “kāfēi” hé “měishì kāfēi” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「咖啡与咖啡馆」吧！你知道“咖啡”和“美式咖啡”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Coffee & Cafe Culture"! Do you know how to use "coffee" (咖啡) and "Americano" (美式咖啡)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào kāfēi, měishì kāfēi háiyǒu nátiě.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到咖啡、美式咖啡还有拿铁。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use coffee (咖啡), Americano (美式咖啡), and latte (拿铁).

对，特别是卡布奇诺、摩卡和浓缩咖啡，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #25: 酒类与酒吧)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “酒类与酒吧” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “jiǔ” hé “píjiǔ” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「酒类与酒吧」吧！你知道“酒”和“啤酒”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Alcoholic Drinks & Bar"! Do you know how to use "alcohol / liquor" (酒) and "beer" (啤酒)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào jiǔ, píjiǔ háiyǒu shēngpí.

#26. Weather & Climate (天气与气候) · 21 từ vựng

← Chủ đề 25Chủ đề 27 →

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #26: 天气与气候)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “天气与气候” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “tiānqì” hé “qìhòu” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「天气与气候」吧！你知道“天气”和“气候”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Weather & Climate"! Do you know how to use "weather" (天气) and "climate" (气候)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào tiānqì, qìhòu háiyǒu qíngtiān.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到天气、气候还有晴天。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use weather (天气), climate (气候), and sunny day (晴天).
ANà “yīntiān” hé “duōyún” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“阴天”和“多云”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "overcast / cloudy day" (阴天) and "partly cloudy" (多云)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì yīntiān, duōyún hé xiàyǔ, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是阴天、多云和下雨，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially overcast / cloudy day (阴天), partly cloudy (多云), and to rain (下雨)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

#27. Four Seasons (四季与节气) · 21 từ vựng

← Chủ đề 26Chủ đề 28 →

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #27: 四季与节气)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “四季与节气” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “sìjì” hé “chūntiān” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「四季与节气」吧！你知道“四季”和“春天”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Four Seasons"! Do you know how to use "four seasons" (四季) and "spring" (春天)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào sìjì, chūntiān háiyǒu xiàtiān.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到四季、春天还有夏天。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use four seasons (四季), spring (春天), and summer (夏天).
ANà “qiūtiān” hé “dōngtiān” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“秋天”和“冬天”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "autumn / fall" (秋天) and "winter" (冬天)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì qiūtiān, dōngtiān hé wēnnuǎn, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是秋天、冬天和温暖，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially autumn / fall (秋天), winter (冬天), and warm (温暖)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào yǔzhòu, tàiyáng háiyǒu yuèliang.

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #36: 海洋生物与两栖类)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “海洋生物与两栖类” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “jīngyú” hé “hǎitún” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「海洋生物与两栖类」吧！你知道“鲸鱼”和“海豚”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Marine Life & Amphibians"! Do you know how to use "whale" (鲸鱼) and "dolphin" (海豚)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào jīngyú, hǎitún háiyǒu shāyú.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到鲸鱼、海豚还有鲨鱼。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use whale (鲸鱼), dolphin (海豚), and shark (鲨鱼).
ANà “hǎiguī” hé “shuǐmǔ” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?

对，特别是海龟、水母和珊瑚，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially sea turtle (海龟), jellyfish (水母), and coral (珊瑚)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

#41. Subway / Metro & Public Transit (地铁与公共交通) · 21 từ vựng

← Chủ đề 40Chủ đề 42 →

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #41: 地铁与公共交通)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “地铁与公共交通” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “dìtiě” hé “dìtiězhàn” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「地铁与公共交通」吧！你知道“地铁”和“地铁站”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Subway / Metro & Public Transit"! Do you know how to use "subway / metro" (地铁) and "subway station" (地铁站)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào dìtiě, dìtiězhàn háiyǒu gōngjiāochē.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到地铁、地铁站还有公交车。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use subway / metro (地铁), subway station (地铁站), and public bus (公交车).
ANà “gōngjiāozhàn” hé “jiāotōngkǎ” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“公交站”和“交通卡”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "bus stop" (公交站) and "transit card" (交通卡)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì gōngjiāozhàn, jiāotōngkǎ hé sǎomǎ chéngchē, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是公交站、交通卡和扫码乘车，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially bus stop (公交站), transit card (交通卡), and scan QR code to ride (扫码乘车)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #42: 出租车与网约车)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “出租车与网约车” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “chūzūchē” hé “wǎngyuēchē” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「出租车与网约车」吧！你知道“出租车”和“网约车”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Taxi & Ride-Hailing"! Do you know how to use "taxi / cab" (出租车) and "ride-hailing car (Didi, etc.)" (网约车)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào chūzūchē, wǎngyuēchē háiyǒu sījī.

→ Of course! In daily life, we often use taxi / cab (出租车), ride-hailing car (Didi, etc.) (网约车), and driver (司机).
ANà “chéngkè” hé “dǎchē” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“乘客”和“打车”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？

对，特别是乘客、打车和计价器，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially passenger (乘客), to hail / call a taxi (打车), and taximeter (计价器)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

→ Of course! In daily life, we often use daily schedule / routine (作息), to wake up / get out of bed (起床), and to brush teeth (刷牙).
ANà “xǐliǎn” hé “chī zǎofàn” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“洗脸”和“吃早饭”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "to wash face" (洗脸) and "to eat breakfast" (吃早饭)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì xǐliǎn, chī zǎofàn hé shàngbān, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是洗脸、吃早饭和上班，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially to wash face (洗脸), to eat breakfast (吃早饭), and to go to work (上班)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

← Chủ đề 63Chủ đề 65 →

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #64: 护肤与美容保养)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “护肤与美容保养” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “hùfūpǐn” hé “xǐmiànnǎi” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「护肤与美容保养」吧！你知道“护肤品”和“洗面奶”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Skincare & Beauty"! Do you know how to use "skincare products" (护肤品) and "facial cleanser" (洗面奶)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào hùfūpǐn, xǐmiànnǎi háiyǒu shuǎngfūshuǐ.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到护肤品、洗面奶还有爽肤水。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use skincare products (护肤品), facial cleanser (洗面奶), and toner / lotion (爽肤水).
ANà “jīnghuáyè” hé “rǔyè” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“精华液”和“乳液”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "serum / essence" (精华液) and "emulsion / moisturizing lotion" (乳液)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì jīnghuáyè, rǔyè hé miànshuāng, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是精华液、乳液和面霜，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially serum / essence (精华液), emulsion / moisturizing lotion (乳液), and face cream / moisturizer (面霜)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

#73. Water & Winter Sports (水上与冰雪运动) · 21 từ vựng

← Chủ đề 72Chủ đề 74 →

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #73: 水上与冰雪运动)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “水上与冰雪运动” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “yóuyǒng” hé “zìyóuyǒng” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「水上与冰雪运动」吧！你知道“游泳”和“自由泳”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Water & Winter Sports"! Do you know how to use "swimming" (游泳) and "freestyle / front crawl" (自由泳)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào yóuyǒng, zìyóuyǒng háiyǒu wāyǒng.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到游泳、自由泳还有蛙泳。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use swimming (游泳), freestyle / front crawl (自由泳), and breaststroke (蛙泳).
ANà “yǎngyǒng” hé “diéyǒng” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“仰泳”和“蝶泳”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "backstroke" (仰泳) and "butterfly stroke" (蝶泳)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì yǎngyǒng, diéyǒng hé tiàoshuǐ, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是仰泳、蝶泳和跳水，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially backstroke (仰泳), butterfly stroke (蝶泳), and diving (跳水)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #74: 健康生活方式与养生)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “健康生活方式与养生” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “jiànkāng” hé “yǎngshēng” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「健康生活方式与养生」吧！你知道“健康”和“养生”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Healthy Lifestyle & Wellness"! Do you know how to use "health / healthy" (健康) and "wellness / health preservation" (养生)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào jiànkāng, yǎngshēng háiyǒu guīlǜ zuòxī.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到健康、养生还有规律作息。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use health / healthy (健康), wellness / health preservation (养生), and regular daily routine (规律作息).
ANà “jūnhéng yǐnshí” hé “qīngdàn yǐnshí” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“均衡饮食”和“清淡饮食”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "balanced diet" (均衡饮食) and "low-salt and low-oil diet" (清淡饮食)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì jūnhéng yǐnshí, qīngdàn yǐnshí hé bǔchōng shuǐfèn, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是均衡饮食、清淡饮食和补充水分，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially balanced diet (均衡饮食), low-salt and low-oil diet (清淡饮食), and adequate hydration (补充水分)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

#77. Classroom Objects & Stationery (文具与教室用品) · 21 từ vựng

← Chủ đề 76Chủ đề 78 →

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #77: 文具与教室用品)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “文具与教室用品” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “wénjù” hé “qiānbǐ” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「文具与教室用品」吧！你知道“文具”和“铅笔”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Classroom Objects & Stationery"! Do you know how to use "stationery" (文具) and "pencil" (铅笔)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào wénjù, qiānbǐ háiyǒu gāngbǐ.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到文具、铅笔还有钢笔。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use stationery (文具), pencil (铅笔), and fountain pen (钢笔).
ANà “yuánzhūbǐ” hé “zhōngxìngbǐ” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“圆珠笔”和“中性笔”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "ballpoint pen" (圆珠笔) and "gel pen" (中性笔)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì yuánzhūbǐ, zhōngxìngbǐ hé yíngguāngbǐ, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是圆珠笔、中性笔和荧光笔，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially ballpoint pen (圆珠笔), gel pen (中性笔), and highlighter (荧光笔)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

#78. University & Higher Education (大学与高等教育) · 21 từ vựng

← Chủ đề 77Chủ đề 79 →

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #78: 大学与高等教育)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “大学与高等教育” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “dàxué” hé “xuéyuàn” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「大学与高等教育」吧！你知道“大学”和“学院”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "University & Higher Education"! Do you know how to use "university" (大学) and "college / faculty / school" (学院)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào dàxué, xuéyuàn háiyǒu xì.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到大学、学院还有系。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use university (大学), college / faculty / school (学院), and academic department (系).
ANà “zhuānyè” hé “běnkēshēng” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“专业”和“本科生”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "academic major / field of study" (专业) and "undergraduate student" (本科生)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì zhuānyè, běnkēshēng hé yánjiūshēng, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是专业、本科生和研究生，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially academic major / field of study (专业), undergraduate student (本科生), and postgraduate / master's student (研究生)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #79: 考试测验与学业评估)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “考试测验与学业评估” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “kǎoshì” hé “cèyàn” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「考试测验与学业评估」吧！你知道“考试”和“测验”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Exams, Tests & Academic Assessment"! Do you know how to use "exam / test" (考试) and "quiz / quick test" (测验)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào kǎoshì, cèyàn háiyǒu qīzhōngkǎo.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到考试、测验还有期中考。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use exam / test (考试), quiz / quick test (测验), and midterm examination (期中考).
ANà “qīmòkǎo” hé “gāokǎo” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“期末考”和“高考”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "final examination" (期末考) and "National College Entrance Exam" (高考)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì qīmòkǎo, gāokǎo hé zhōngkǎo, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是期末考、高考和中考，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially final examination (期末考), National College Entrance Exam (高考), and High School Entrance Exam (中考)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #80: 语言学习与语言学)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “语言学习与语言学” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “hànyǔ” hé “pǔtōnghuà” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「语言学习与语言学」吧！你知道“汉语”和“普通话”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Language Learning & Linguistics"! Do you know how to use "Chinese language" (汉语) and "Standard Mandarin Chinese" (普通话)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào hànyǔ, pǔtōnghuà háiyǒu shēngdiào.

→ Of course! In daily life, we often use Chinese language (汉语), Standard Mandarin Chinese (普通话), and tones (in Mandarin) (声调).
ANà “pīnyīn” hé “hànzì” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?

对，特别是拼音、汉字和部首，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially Pinyin romanization (拼音), Chinese characters (汉字), and radicals of Chinese characters (部首)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “图书馆与阅读体验” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “túshūguǎn” hé “túshū guǎnlǐyuán” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「图书馆与阅读体验」吧！你知道“图书馆”和“图书管理员”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Library & Reading"! Do you know how to use "library" (图书馆) and "librarian" (图书管理员)?

当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到图书馆、图书管理员还有借书证。

对，特别是借书、还书和续借，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！

#82. Professions & Occupations (职业与岗位称谓) · 21 từ vựng

← Chủ đề 81Chủ đề 83 →

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #82: 职业与岗位称谓)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “职业与岗位称谓” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “zhíyè” hé “gōngchéngshī” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「职业与岗位称谓」吧！你知道“职业”和“工程师”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Professions & Occupations"! Do you know how to use "profession / career" (职业) and "engineer" (工程师)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào zhíyè, gōngchéngshī háiyǒu chéngxùyuán.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到职业、工程师还有程序员。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use profession / career (职业), engineer (工程师), and programmer / software developer (程序员).
ANà “yīshēng” hé “hùshi” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“医生”和“护士”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "doctor" (医生) and "nurse" (护士)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì yīshēng, hùshi hé jiàoshī, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是医生、护士和教师，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially doctor (医生), nurse (护士), and teacher (教师)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #86: 商务会议与职场沟通)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “商务会议与职场沟通” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “kāihuì” hé “huìyì yìchéng” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「商务会议与职场沟通」吧！你知道“开会”和“会议议程”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Business Meetings & Workplace Communication"! Do you know how to use "to hold a meeting" (开会) and "meeting agenda" (会议议程)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào kāihuì, huìyì yìchéng háiyǒu zhǔchírén.

→ Of course! In daily life, we often use to hold a meeting (开会), meeting agenda (会议议程), and meeting host / moderator (主持人).
ANà “fāyán” hé “zuò huìbào” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?

#91. Money, Currency & Mobile Payments (货币、金钱与移动支付) · 21 từ vựng

← Chủ đề 90Chủ đề 92 →

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #91: 货币、金钱与移动支付)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “货币、金钱与移动支付” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “rénmínbì” hé “yuán” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「货币、金钱与移动支付」吧！你知道“人民币”和“元”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Money, Currency & Mobile Payments"! Do you know how to use "Renminbi (RMB) / Chinese Yuan" (人民币) and "Yuan (formal / colloquial)" (元)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào rénmínbì, yuán háiyǒu jiǎo.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到人民币、元还有角。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use Renminbi (RMB) / Chinese Yuan (人民币), Yuan (formal / colloquial) (元), and Jiao (1/10 yuan, formal / colloquial) (角).
ANà “fēn” hé “xiànjīn” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“分”和“现金”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "Fen (1/100 yuan / cent)" (分) and "cash" (现金)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì fēn, xiànjīn hé zhǐbì, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是分、现金和纸币，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially Fen (1/100 yuan / cent) (分), cash (现金), and paper banknote (纸币)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

#95. Clothing Shopping & Fitting (商场服装购物与试穿) · 21 từ vựng

← Chủ đề 94Chủ đề 96 →

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #95: 商场服装购物与试穿)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “商场服装购物与试穿” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “shāngchǎng” hé “shìyījiān” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「商场服装购物与试穿」吧！你知道“商场”和“试衣间”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Clothing Shopping & Fitting"! Do you know how to use "shopping mall" (商场) and "fitting room / dressing room" (试衣间)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào shāngchǎng, shìyījiān háiyǒu shìchuān.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到商场、试衣间还有试穿。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use shopping mall (商场), fitting room / dressing room (试衣间), and to try on clothes (试穿).
ANà “chǐmǎ” hé “dàhào” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“尺码”和“大号”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "clothing size" (尺码) and "Large (L)" (大号)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì chǐmǎ, dàhào hé zhōnghào, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是尺码、大号和中号，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially clothing size (尺码), Large (L) (大号), and Medium (M) (中号)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

#96. Bargaining, Discounts & Sales (砍价议价、折扣与促销) · 21 từ vựng

← Chủ đề 95Chủ đề 97 →

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #96: 砍价议价、折扣与促销)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “砍价议价、折扣与促销” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “kǎnjià” hé “dǎzhé” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「砍价议价、折扣与促销」吧！你知道“砍价”和“打折”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Bargaining, Discounts & Sales"! Do you know how to use "to bargain / haggle" (砍价) and "to give a discount" (打折)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào kǎnjià, dǎzhé háiyǒu bāzhé.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到砍价、打折还有八折。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use to bargain / haggle (砍价), to give a discount (打折), and 20% off (pay 80%) (八折).
ANà “wǔzhé” hé “yōuhuìquàn” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“五折”和“优惠券”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "50% off / half price" (五折) and "coupon / voucher" (优惠券)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì wǔzhé, yōuhuìquàn hé mǎnjiǎn, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是五折、优惠券和满减，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially 50% off / half price (五折), coupon / voucher (优惠券), and discount upon spending a threshold (满减)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

今天我们聊聊「保险保障与税收政策」吧！你知道“保险”和“投保人”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Insurance & Taxation"! Do you know how to use "insurance" (保险) and "policyholder" (投保人)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào bǎoxiǎn, tóubǎorén háiyǒu bèibǎoxiǎnrén.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到保险、投保人还有被保险人。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use insurance (保险), policyholder (投保人), and insured person (被保险人).
ANà “shòuyìrén” hé “bǎofèi” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“受益人”和“保费”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "beneficiary" (受益人) and "insurance premium" (保费)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì shòuyìrén, bǎofèi hé bǎo'é, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是受益人、保费和保额，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially beneficiary (受益人), insurance premium (保费), and coverage amount / insured sum (保额)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #104: 人工智能与前沿科技)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “人工智能与前沿科技” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “réngōng zhìnéng” hé “jīqì xuéxí” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「人工智能与前沿科技」吧！你知道“人工智能”和“机器学习”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Artificial Intelligence & Emerging Tech"! Do you know how to use "Artificial Intelligence (AI)" (人工智能) and "machine learning" (机器学习)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào réngōng zhìnéng, jīqì xuéxí háiyǒu shēndù xuéxí.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到人工智能、机器学习还有深度学习。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use Artificial Intelligence (AI) (人工智能), machine learning (机器学习), and deep learning (深度学习).
ANà “shénjīng wǎngluò” hé “dà yǔyán móxíng” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“神经网络”和“大语言模型”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "neural network" (神经网络) and "Large Language Model (LLM)" (大语言模型)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì shénjīng wǎngluò, dà yǔyán móxíng hé suànfǎ, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是神经网络、大语言模型和算法，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially neural network (神经网络), Large Language Model (LLM) (大语言模型), and algorithm (算法)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #108: 电影艺术与影院观影)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “电影艺术与影院观影” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “diànyǐng” hé “diànyǐngyuàn” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「电影艺术与影院观影」吧！你知道“电影”和“电影院”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Movies, Cinema & Film Industry"! Do you know how to use "movie / film" (电影) and "cinema / movie theater" (电影院)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào diànyǐng, diànyǐngyuàn háiyǒu dàyínmù.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到电影、电影院还有大银幕。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use movie / film (电影), cinema / movie theater (电影院), and big screen (大银幕).
ANà “bàomǐhuā” hé “dǎoyǎn” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“爆米花”和“导演”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "popcorn" (爆米花) and "film director" (导演)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì bàomǐhuā, dǎoyǎn hé biānjù, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是爆米花、导演和编剧，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially popcorn (爆米花), film director (导演), and screenwriter / scriptwriter (编剧)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

今天我们聊聊「文学阅读、小说与诗歌」吧！你知道“文学”和“小说”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Reading, Literature & Poetry"! Do you know how to use "literature" (文学) and "novel / fiction" (小说)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào wénxué, xiǎoshuō háiyǒu chángpiān xiǎoshuō.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到文学、小说还有长篇小说。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use literature (文学), novel / fiction (小说), and full-length novel (长篇小说).
ANà “duǎnpiān xiǎoshuō” hé “sǎnwén” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“短篇小说”和“散文”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "short story" (短篇小说) and "prose / essay" (散文)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì duǎnpiān xiǎoshuō, sǎnwén hé shīgē, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是短篇小说、散文和诗歌，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially short story (短篇小说), prose / essay (散文), and poetry / verse (诗歌)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

#117. Horticulture & Home Gardening (园艺花艺与家庭种植) · 21 từ vựng

← Chủ đề 116Chủ đề 118 →

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #117: 园艺花艺与家庭种植)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “园艺花艺与家庭种植” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “yuányì” hé “pénzāi” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「园艺花艺与家庭种植」吧！你知道“园艺”和“盆栽”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Horticulture & Home Gardening"! Do you know how to use "gardening / horticulture" (园艺) and "potted plant / bonsai" (盆栽)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào yuányì, pénzāi háiyǒu duōròu zhíwù.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到园艺、盆栽还有多肉植物。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use gardening / horticulture (园艺), potted plant / bonsai (盆栽), and succulent plant (多肉植物).
ANà “lǜluó” hé “fācáishù” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“绿萝”和“发财树”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "pothos / devil's ivy" (绿萝) and "Pachira money tree" (发财树)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì lǜluó, fācáishù hé guībèizhú, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是绿萝、发财树和龟背竹，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially pothos / devil's ivy (绿萝), Pachira money tree (发财树), and Monstera deliciosa (龟背竹)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào shǒucáng, cángpǐn háiyǒu gǔdǒng.

#121. Western & International Holidays (西方与国际节日) · 21 từ vựng

← Chủ đề 120Chủ đề 122 →

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #121: 西方与国际节日)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “西方与国际节日” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “yuándàn” hé “guójì láodòngjié” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「西方与国际节日」吧！你知道“元旦”和“国际劳动节”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Western & International Holidays"! Do you know how to use "New Year's Day (Jan 1)" (元旦) and "International Workers' Day (May 1)" (国际劳动节)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào yuándàn, guójì láodòngjié háiyǒu guójì fùnǚjié.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到元旦、国际劳动节还有国际妇女节。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use New Year's Day (Jan 1) (元旦), International Workers' Day (May 1) (国际劳动节), and International Women's Day (Mar 8) (国际妇女节).
ANà “értóngjié” hé “jiàoshījié” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“儿童节”和“教师节”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "Children's Day (June 1)" (儿童节) and "Teachers' Day (Sept 10 in China)" (教师节)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì értóngjié, jiàoshījié hé guóqìngjié, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是儿童节、教师节和国庆节，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially Children's Day (June 1) (儿童节), Teachers' Day (Sept 10 in China) (教师节), and National Day (Oct 1 in China) (国庆节)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

#122. Birthdays & Anniversaries (生日与纪念日庆祝) · 21 từ vựng

← Chủ đề 121Chủ đề 123 →

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #122: 生日与纪念日庆祝)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “生日与纪念日庆祝” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “shēngrì” hé “zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「生日与纪念日庆祝」吧！你知道“生日”和“祝你生日快乐”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Birthdays & Anniversaries"! Do you know how to use "birthday" (生日) and "Happy Birthday to you!" (祝你生日快乐)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào shēngrì, zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè háiyǒu shēngrì dàngāo.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到生日、祝你生日快乐还有生日蛋糕。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use birthday (生日), Happy Birthday to you! (祝你生日快乐), and birthday cake (生日蛋糕).
ANà “chuī làzhú” hé “xǔyuàn” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“吹蜡烛”和“许愿”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "blow out the candles" (吹蜡烛) and "make a birthday wish" (许愿)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì chuī làzhú, xǔyuàn hé shēngrì lǐwù, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是吹蜡烛、许愿和生日礼物，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially blow out the candles (吹蜡烛), make a birthday wish (许愿), and birthday gift / present (生日礼物)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

#123. Weddings & Marriage Traditions (婚礼仪式与婚俗文化) · 21 từ vựng

← Chủ đề 122Chủ đề 124 →

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #123: 婚礼仪式与婚俗文化)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “婚礼仪式与婚俗文化” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “jiéhūn” hé “qiúhūn” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「婚礼仪式与婚俗文化」吧！你知道“结婚”和“求婚”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Weddings & Marriage Traditions"! Do you know how to use "to marry / get married" (结婚) and "to propose marriage" (求婚)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào jiéhūn, qiúhūn háiyǒu dìnghūn.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到结婚、求婚还有订婚。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use to marry / get married (结婚), to propose marriage (求婚), and engagement / betrothal (订婚).
ANà “xīnláng” hé “xīnniáng” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“新郎”和“新娘”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "bridegroom / groom" (新郎) and "bride" (新娘)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì xīnláng, xīnniáng hé bànláng, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是新郎、新娘和伴郎，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially bridegroom / groom (新郎), bride (新娘), and best man / groomsman (伴郎)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

#124. Chinese Cultural Symbols & Heritage (中华文化符号与国粹) · 21 từ vựng

← Chủ đề 123Chủ đề 125 →

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #124: 中华文化符号与国粹)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “中华文化符号与国粹” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “guócuì” hé “shūfǎ” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「中华文化符号与国粹」吧！你知道“国粹”和“书法”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Chinese Cultural Symbols & Heritage"! Do you know how to use "quintessence of Chinese culture" (国粹) and "calligraphy" (书法)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào guócuì, shūfǎ háiyǒu wénfáng sìbǎo.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到国粹、书法还有文房四宝。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use quintessence of Chinese culture (国粹), calligraphy (书法), and Four Treasures of the Study (brush, ink, paper, inkstone) (文房四宝).
ANà “máobǐ” hé “xuānzhǐ” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“毛笔”和“宣纸”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "ink brush" (毛笔) and "Xuan rice paper" (宣纸)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì máobǐ, xuānzhǐ hé mòzhī, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是毛笔、宣纸和墨汁，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially ink brush (毛笔), Xuan rice paper (宣纸), and Chinese black ink (墨汁)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

#125. Government & Public Administration (国家治理与公共行政) · 21 từ vựng

← Chủ đề 124Chủ đề 126 →

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #125: 国家治理与公共行政)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “国家治理与公共行政” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “zhèngfǔ” hé “guójiā” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「国家治理与公共行政」吧！你知道“政府”和“国家”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Government & Public Administration"! Do you know how to use "government" (政府) and "country / state / nation" (国家)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào zhèngfǔ, guójiā háiyǒu zhèngcè.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到政府、国家还有政策。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use government (政府), country / state / nation (国家), and policy (政策).
ANà “guówùyuàn” hé “réndà dàibiǎo” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“国务院”和“人大代表”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "State Council" (国务院) and "National People's Congress deputy" (人大代表)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì guówùyuàn, réndà dàibiǎo hé zhèngxié wěiyuán, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是国务院、人大代表和政协委员，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially State Council (国务院), National People's Congress deputy (人大代表), and CPPCC committee member (政协委员)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

#126. Law, Court & Legal System (法律法庭与司法体系) · 21 từ vựng

← Chủ đề 125Chủ đề 127 →

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #126: 法律法庭与司法体系)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “法律法庭与司法体系” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “fǎlǜ” hé “xiànfǎ” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「法律法庭与司法体系」吧！你知道“法律”和“宪法”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Law, Court & Legal System"! Do you know how to use "law" (法律) and "constitution" (宪法)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào fǎlǜ, xiànfǎ háiyǒu mínfǎdiǎn.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到法律、宪法还有民法典。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use law (法律), constitution (宪法), and civil code (民法典).
ANà “xíngfǎ” hé “fǎyuàn” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“刑法”和“法院”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "criminal law" (刑法) and "court of law" (法院)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì xíngfǎ, fǎyuàn hé jiǎncháyuàn, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是刑法、法院和检察院，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially criminal law (刑法), court of law (法院), and procuratorate / prosecutor's office (检察院)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

#127. Police, Crime & Public Safety (警务执法、犯罪与社会治安) · 21 từ vựng

← Chủ đề 126Chủ đề 128 →

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #127: 警务执法、犯罪与社会治安)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “警务执法、犯罪与社会治安” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “jǐngchá” hé “gōng'ānjú” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「警务执法、犯罪与社会治安」吧！你知道“警察”和“公安局”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Police, Crime & Public Safety"! Do you know how to use "police officer" (警察) and "Public Security Bureau" (公安局)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào jǐngchá, gōng'ānjú háiyǒu pàichūsuǒ.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到警察、公安局还有派出所。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use police officer (警察), Public Security Bureau (公安局), and local police substation (派出所).
ANà “bōdǎ yāoyāolíng” hé “bàojǐng” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“拨打110”和“报警”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "dial 110 (police emergency in China)" (拨打110) and "report an incident to police" (报警)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì bōdǎ yāoyāolíng, bàojǐng hé chūjǐng, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是拨打110、报警和出警，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially dial 110 (police emergency in China) (拨打110), report an incident to police (报警), and police dispatch / responding to call (出警)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

#130. Philosophy & Ethics (哲学思辨与伦理道德) · 21 từ vựng

← Chủ đề 129Chủ đề 131 →

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #130: 哲学思辨与伦理道德)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “哲学思辨与伦理道德” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “zhéxué” hé “zhéxuéjiā” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「哲学思辨与伦理道德」吧！你知道“哲学”和“哲学家”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Philosophy & Ethics"! Do you know how to use "philosophy" (哲学) and "philosopher" (哲学家)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào zhéxué, zhéxuéjiā háiyǒu rújiā sīxiǎng.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到哲学、哲学家还有儒家思想。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use philosophy (哲学), philosopher (哲学家), and Confucianism (儒家思想).
ANà “kǒngzǐ” hé “mèngzǐ” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“孔子”和“孟子”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "Confucius" (孔子) and "Mencius" (孟子)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì kǒngzǐ, mèngzǐ hé lǎozǐ, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是孔子、孟子和老子，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially Confucius (孔子), Mencius (孟子), and Laozi (老子)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #131: 历史朝代与考古发现)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “历史朝代与考古发现” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “lìshǐ” hé “cháodài” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「历史朝代与考古发现」吧！你知道“历史”和“朝代”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "History, Dynasties & Archaeology"! Do you know how to use "history" (历史) and "dynasty" (朝代)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào lìshǐ, cháodài háiyǒu qíncháo.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到历史、朝代还有秦朝。

对，特别是汉朝、唐朝和宋朝，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially Han Dynasty (汉朝), Tang Dynasty (Golden Age) (唐朝), and Song Dynasty (宋朝)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #132: 时间表达与钟点表达)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “时间表达与钟点表达” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “shíjiān” hé “jǐdiǎn” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「时间表达与钟点表达」吧！你知道“时间”和“几点”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Time Expressions & Clock Time"! Do you know how to use "time" (时间) and "what time / what hour?" (几点)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào shíjiān, jǐdiǎn háiyǒu diǎnzhōng.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到时间、几点还有点钟。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use time (时间), what time / what hour? (几点), and o'clock (点钟).
ANà “bàn” hé “kè” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“半”和“刻”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "half past (e.g. 3:30)" (半) and "quarter of an hour (15 mins)" (刻)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì bàn, kè hé fēnzhōng, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是半、刻和分钟，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially half past (e.g. 3:30) (半), quarter of an hour (15 mins) (刻), and minute (分钟)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “基数词、序数词与分百数” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “líng” hé “yī” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「基数词、序数词与分百数」吧！你知道“零”和“一”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Cardinal Numbers, Ordinals & Fractions"! Do you know how to use "zero (0)" (零) and "one (1)" (一)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào líng, yī háiyǒu èr.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到零、一还有二。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use zero (0) (零), one (1) (一), and two (2) (二).
ANà “sān” hé “sì” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“三”和“四”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "three (3)" (三) and "four (4)" (四)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì sān, sì hé wǔ, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是三、四和五，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially three (3) (三), four (4) (四), and five (5) (五)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

#135. Essential Chinese Measure Words / Classifiers (常用中文量词分类) · 21 từ vựng

← Chủ đề 134Chủ đề 136 →

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #135: 常用中文量词分类)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “常用中文量词分类” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “gè” hé “zhī” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「常用中文量词分类」吧！你知道“个”和“只”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Essential Chinese Measure Words / Classifiers"! Do you know how to use "general measure word (people, items)" (个) and "for animals, birds, or one of a pair" (只)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào gè, zhī háiyǒu tiáo.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到个、只还有条。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use general measure word (people, items) (个), for animals, birds, or one of a pair (只), and for long slender items (fish, roads, pants) (条).
ANà “zhāng” hé “běn” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“张”和“本”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "for flat items (paper, tickets, tables, photos)" (张) and "for bound books, magazines, notebooks" (本)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì zhāng, běn hé zhī, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是张、本和支，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially for flat items (paper, tickets, tables, photos) (张), for bound books, magazines, notebooks (本), and for stick-like objects (pens, pencils, cigarettes) (支)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #136: 日常问候与社交礼貌用语)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “日常问候与社交礼貌用语” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “nǐ hǎo” hé “nín hǎo” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「日常问候与社交礼貌用语」吧！你知道“你好”和“您好”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Basic Greetings, Social Niceties & Courtesies"! Do you know how to use "hello / hi" (你好) and "hello (polite / respectful form)" (您好)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào nǐ hǎo, nín hǎo háiyǒu zǎoshang hǎo.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到你好、您好还有早上好。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use hello / hi (你好), hello (polite / respectful form) (您好), and good morning (早上好).
ANà “xiàwǔ hǎo” hé “wǎnshang hǎo” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“下午好”和“晚上好”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "good afternoon" (下午好) and "good evening" (晚上好)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì xiàwǔ hǎo, wǎnshang hǎo hé wǎn'ān, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是下午好、晚上好和晚安，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially good afternoon (下午好), good evening (晚上好), and good night (晚安)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #137: 观点表达、赞同与异议)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “观点表达、赞同与异议” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “wǒ juéde” hé “zài wǒ kànlái” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「观点表达、赞同与异议」吧！你知道“我觉得”和“在我看来”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Expressing Opinions, Agreement & Disagreement"! Do you know how to use "I think / I believe" (我觉得) and "in my view / from my perspective" (在我看来)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào wǒ juéde, zài wǒ kànlái háiyǒu tóngyì.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到我觉得、在我看来还有同意。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use I think / I believe (我觉得), in my view / from my perspective (在我看来), and to agree (同意).
ANà “wánquán zàntóng” hé “fǎnduì” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“完全赞同”和“反对”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "totally agree" (完全赞同) and "to oppose / disagree" (反对)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì wánquán zàntóng, fǎnduì hé chí bǎoliú yìjiàn, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是完全赞同、反对和持保留意见，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially totally agree (完全赞同), to oppose / disagree (反对), and have reservations (持保留意见)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

#139. Requests, Offers, Suggestions & Invitations (请求、提议、建议与邀约) · 21 từ vựng

← Chủ đề 138Chủ đề 140 →

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #139: 请求、提议、建议与邀约)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “请求、提议、建议与邀约” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “kěyǐ bāng wǒ ma” hé “qǐng gěi wǒ...” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「请求、提议、建议与邀约」吧！你知道“可以帮我吗”和“请给我...”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Requests, Offers, Suggestions & Invitations"! Do you know how to use "could you help me?" (可以帮我吗) and "please give me..." (请给我...)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào kěyǐ bāng wǒ ma, qǐng gěi wǒ... háiyǒu máfan nǐ le.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到可以帮我吗、请给我...还有麻烦你了。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use could you help me? (可以帮我吗), please give me... (请给我...), and trouble you / sorry for the bother (麻烦你了).
ANà “xūyào bāngzhù ma” hé “yào bu yào...” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“需要帮助吗”和“要不要...”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "do you need help?" (需要帮助吗) and "would you like to / do you want...?" (要不要...)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì xūyào bāngzhù ma, yào bu yào... hé wǒ jiànyì..., zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是需要帮助吗、要不要...和我建议...，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially do you need help? (需要帮助吗), would you like to / do you want...? (要不要...), and I suggest / recommend... (我建议...)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

#140. Apologies, Gratitude & Relieving Excuses (道歉致歉、致谢与托辞) · 21 từ vựng

← Chủ đề 139Chủ đề 141 →

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #140: 道歉致歉、致谢与托辞)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “道歉致歉、致谢与托辞” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “zhēn bù hǎoyìsi” hé “bàoqiàn” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「道歉致歉、致谢与托辞」吧！你知道“真不好意思”和“抱歉”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Apologies, Gratitude & Relieving Excuses"! Do you know how to use "truly very sorry / embarrassed" (真不好意思) and "I apologize / apologies" (抱歉)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào zhēn bù hǎoyìsi, bàoqiàn háiyǒu qǐng yuánliàng.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到真不好意思、抱歉还有请原谅。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use truly very sorry / embarrassed (真不好意思), I apologize / apologies (抱歉), and please forgive me (请原谅).
ANà “wǒ bùshì gùyì de” hé “wǒ de cuò” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“我不是故意的”和“我的错”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "I didn't mean to do it on purpose" (我不是故意的) and "it's my fault / my bad" (我的错)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì wǒ bùshì gùyì de, wǒ de cuò hé fēicháng gǎnxiè, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是我不是故意的、我的错和非常感谢，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially I didn't mean to do it on purpose (我不是故意的), it's my fault / my bad (我的错), and thank you very much (非常感谢)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #141: 电话联络、即时通讯与语音)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “电话联络、即时通讯与语音” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “dǎ diànhuà” hé “jiē diànhuà” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「电话联络、即时通讯与语音」吧！你知道“打电话”和“接电话”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Phone Calls, Messaging & Voice Notes"! Do you know how to use "to make a phone call" (打电话) and "to answer the phone" (接电话)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào dǎ diànhuà, jiē diànhuà háiyǒu wéi, nǐ hǎo.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到打电话、接电话还有喂，你好。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use to make a phone call (打电话), to answer the phone (接电话), and hello? (phone greeting) (喂，你好).
ANà “guàduàn” hé “zhànxiàn” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“挂断”和“占线”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "to hang up" (挂断) and "line is busy" (占线)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì guàduàn, zhànxiàn hé wèijiē láidiàn, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是挂断、占线和未接来电，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially to hang up (挂断), line is busy (占线), and missed call (未接来电)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

对，特别是摩擦力、浮力和惯性，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！

← Chủ đề 142Chủ đề 144 →

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #143: 基础化学、元素与常见材料)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “基础化学、元素与常见材料” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “huàxué” hé “yuánsù zhōuqībǐao” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「基础化学、元素与常见材料」吧！你知道“化学”和“元素周期表”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Chemistry, Elements & Materials"! Do you know how to use "chemistry" (化学) and "Periodic Table of Elements" (元素周期表)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào huàxué, yuánsù zhōuqībǐao háiyǒu yuánzǐ.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到化学、元素周期表还有原子。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use chemistry (化学), Periodic Table of Elements (元素周期表), and atom (原子).
ANà “fēnzǐ” hé “huàxué fǎnyìng” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“分子”和“化学反应”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "molecule" (分子) and "chemical reaction" (化学反应)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì fēnzǐ, huàxué fǎnyìng hé róngyè, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是分子、化学反应和溶液，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially molecule (分子), chemical reaction (化学反应), and solution (溶液)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #148: 空间方位、相对位置与导向)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “空间方位、相对位置与导向” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “fāngxiàng” hé “dōng” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「空间方位、相对位置与导向」吧！你知道“方向”和“东”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Spatial Directions, Locations & Orientations"! Do you know how to use "direction" (方向) and "east" (东)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào fāngxiàng, dōng háiyǒu nán.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到方向、东还有南。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use direction (方向), east (东), and south (南).
ANà “xī” hé “běi” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“西”和“北”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "west" (西) and "north" (北)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì xī, běi hé dōngnán, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是西、北和东南，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially west (西), north (北), and southeast (东南)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #149: 高频反义形容词与事物性质)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “高频反义形容词与事物性质” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “dà” hé “duō” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「高频反义形容词与事物性质」吧！你知道“大”和“多”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Essential Opposite Adjectives & Qualities"! Do you know how to use "big / small" (大) and "many / few (much / little)" (多)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào dà, duō háiyǒu cháng.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到大、多还有长。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use big / small (大), many / few (much / little) (多), and long / short (length) (长).
ANà “gāo” hé “kuān” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“高”和“宽”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？

BDuì, tèbié shì gāo, kuān hé hòu, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是高、宽和厚，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially tall / short (height) (高), wide / narrow (宽), and thick / thin (厚)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!

💬 1. Hội thoại thực tế ứng dụng (Chủ đề #150: 日常生活高频核心动作动词)

AJīntiān wǒmen liáoliao “日常生活高频核心动作动词” ba! Nǐ zhīdào “kàn” hé “tīng” zěnme yòng ma?
今天我们聊聊「日常生活高频核心动作动词」吧！你知道“看”和“听”怎么用吗？
→ Today let's talk about "Essential Action Verbs for Daily Life"! Do you know how to use "to see / look / watch / read" (看) and "to hear / listen" (听)?
BDāngrán zhīdào! Zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen jīngcháng huì yòngdào kàn, tīng háiyǒu shuō.
当然知道！在日常生活中，我们经常会用到看、听还有说。
→ Of course! In daily life, we often use to see / look / watch / read (看), to hear / listen (听), and to speak / say (说).
ANà “dú” hé “xiě” ne? Zài zhège chǎngjǐng lǐ yě hěn chángjiàn ba?
那“读”和“写”呢？在这个场景里也很常见吧？
→ What about "to read aloud / read" (读) and "to write" (写)? They are also very common in this scenario, right?
BDuì, tèbié shì dú, xiě hé chī, zhǎngwò zhèxiē cí jiù néng liúlì jiāoliú le!
对，特别是读、写和吃，掌握这些词就能流利交流了！
→ Yes, especially to read aloud / read (读), to write (写), and to eat (吃)—mastering these lets you communicate fluently!
